share_policy: Store category shares or company/brand shares only when explicitly disclosed in a public source. Never infer or reconstruct paid-report market shares from snippets. If comparing share, use percentage-point change rather than percent growth.
comparison_policy: Every public comparative value must identify comparison type and base period where practical. Market-size forecasts remain secondary evidence and must not be mixed with official retail or shipment observations.
interpretation: Official statistics remain the primary evidence for actual activity. Industry-research estimates are secondary context for category structure, growth expectations and published share information.
